item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 15/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Upper-air disturbances will bring a few showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong at first tomorrow. The northeast monsoon will affect southern China in the next few days. Meanwhile, the broad area of low pressure near Luzon will develop gradually in the next couple of days. It will then have a higher chance to move westwards across the central and northern parts of the South China Sea, but its movement and development remain uncertain. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Bebinca will move across the East China Sea and edge closer to the coast of eastern China gradually today. It will then move inland and weaken gradually.
